purpose: Test one exact-tradable, fully invested equity baseline that diversifies broad-market, dividend-growth, and net-buyback return sources without exposure timing.

selection_rationale.VIG: fully invested dividend-growth equity with exact tradable history from 2006-04-21
selection_rationale.PKW: net-share-reduction equity with exact tradable history from 2006-12-20
selection_rationale.equal_weights: prevents retrospective weighting optimization and keeps broad-market participation explicit

rejected_mechanisms.QUAL_USMV_factor_blend: ETF histories begin after the locked prehistory window
rejected_mechanisms.managed_futures_overlay: tradable ETF history is too short
rejected_mechanisms.option_tail_hedge: free data stack lacks defensible historical option surfaces
rejected_mechanisms.another_exposure_scaling_rule: trend, volatility, drawdown, and portfolio-insurance mechanisms have already been tested

data.source: Yahoo adjusted daily chart data for validation-only research

interpretation_rule: A pass creates a candidate for separate frozen replication and forward observation only; it never authorizes trading.
